summary.one_liner: An unofficial desktop GroupMe client built with Electron.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes GroupMe as an unofficial GroupMe app packaged with Electron. It includes a Linux setup step that creates a .desktop launcher file pointing at the app binary and its icon. Development commands cover installing dependencies, running the app locally, and building packages for macOS, Windows, and Linux. The README does not describe specific chat features, screens, or settings. It is licensed under MIT by Devin Rousso.
use_cases: Use GroupMe chat on a desktop computer
Run a GroupMe client on Linux with a desktop launcher
Build a GroupMe desktop app for macOS, Windows, or Linux
Study or modify an Electron-based chat client
notable: Unofficial GroupMe desktop client, not affiliated with GroupMe
Per-platform build scripts for macOS, Windows, and Linux
Includes a Linux .desktop shortcut setup for application launchers
caveats: README is minimal and does not list features or screenshots
Unofficial app, so it is not maintained or supported by GroupMe
Download section names a current release but gives no link or version details
